name: io.github.KamaruSama/mcp-screenshot
description: Take Wayland screenshots via grim/slurp. Full screen, region, or interactive crop.

environmentVariables.description: Wayland display identifier (e.g. wayland-1). Required for grim to find the compositor.
environmentVariables.name: WAYLAND_DISPLAY

environmentVariables.description: Wayland runtime directory (e.g. /run/user/1000). Required for socket lookup.
environmentVariables.name: XDG_RUNTIME_DIR
